items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember he sat in with Rahsaan Roland Kirk one day... He was the happiest cat in the world – not that the song was over – that he got a chance to play with Rahsaan.

ctx.x: Eric Kloss. Then they had another blind one. Kimery: Plays clarinet too.

Yeah. They had two great young musicians. I think they both were blind, and both played like nobody’s business. I remember Eric Kloss sitting there with Sonny Stitt, would always invite him up, and he always shined. I always thought that him and I would end up playing together, but we never did. Then they had the crazy drummer that was so incredible. What’s his name? In Pittsburgh? Alexander: Spider.
